title.zh: 将莱特省 Malitbog市镇 San Isidro 社区学校的名称变更为Oppus 纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the San Isidro Community School in the Municipality of Malitbog, Province of Leyte, to Oppus Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the San Isidro Community School in the Municipality of Malitbog, Province of Leyte, to Oppus Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên San Isidro Community School tại Thị trấn Malitbog, Tỉnh Leyte thành Oppus Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ San Isidro Community School ในเทศบาล Malitbog, จังหวัด Leyte เป็น Oppus Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama San Isidro Community School di Kotamadya Malitbog, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Oppus Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama San Isidro Community School di Perbandaran Malitbog, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Oppus Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2217_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the San Isidro Community School in the Municipality of Malitbog, Province of Leyte, is changed to Oppus Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
